newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key June JGB futures rise to record high of 127.31.
newsitem.headline: Key June JGB futures rise to record high of 127.31.

text.p: The key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract rose to a record high of 127.31 in Tokyo morning trade on Tuesday.
The key contract's previous high of 127.30 was hit in London overnight on Monday.
Bullish sentiment carried over into the Tokyo market on Tuesday, with active buying in the cash market lending support, traders said.
A slew of recently launched corporate bonds was well-absorbed in the market, they added.
JGB futures also rose due to weakness in Tokyo share prices and comments by Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka interpreted as indicating no rise in domestic interest rates was imminent.
Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday that the ministry's stance on monetary policy matched the views of the Bank of Japan governor.
